run_relax_atoms: run atomic structure relaxation on ASE Atoms using the FIRE optimizer with a force convergence threshold
run_relax_atoms_with_symmetry: run atomic relaxation with fixed symmetry constraints to preserve crystal symmetry during optimization
run_relax_atoms_with_cell_filter: run atomic relaxation with a cell filter to allow variable-cell optimization of the unit cell
run_relax_atoms_with_observers: run atomic relaxation with observer callbacks attached to monitor optimization progress at set intervals
run_relax_atoms_custom_optimizer: run atomic relaxation with a custom ASE optimizer class instead of the default FIRE optimizer
